_README: Q299 containment audit of every structure on all six pages: scripts/anatomy/q299/contain299.py.

Body mask = the page's own skin + fat_subcut/fat_deep/soft_unlabelled surfaces, area-sampled >=1 pt/mm2 into a 2 mm grid, closed with an 8 mm morphological closing done as dilate -> flood the outside from the grid border -> erode back, largest component.
VALIDATED three ways: >=90 % of 26 deep structures >=99.5 % inside and the group mean >=99 %; the mask volume a plausible body volume; the mask boundary within p95 3 mm of a real skin sample.
Distances are true mm to the nearest real skin/outer-tissue surface sample (cKDTree), not voxel distances. Read every offender distance against that page's own error band.
